name: codebase-scanner
description: Scan codebase structure, detect frameworks, modules, entry points, No-Go Zones

setup_questions.question: Scope scan?
setup_questions.description: full = toàn bộ project. src-only = chỉ src/. custom = specify paths.

setup_questions.question: Có scan test files không?
setup_questions.description: Scan tests giúp đánh giá coverage hiện tại.

setup_questions.question: Có scan config files không?
setup_questions.description: Scan configs giúp detect linting, CI/CD, và DevOps setup.

setup_questions.question: Max file size để đọc nội dung (KB)?
setup_questions.description: Files lớn hơn sẽ chỉ đọc header. Giúp tránh timeout.

hooks.pre_scan: Check project structure exists → detect package manager → detect language/framework
hooks.post_scan: Generate context.md draft → mark all inferences with [⚠️ AI-inferred]

memory.purpose: Track scan efficiency — optimize future scans
